base: frozen28 product; single existing test compared with immediately reread shared file after root fixture migration
scope: Retain original exact config registry/source address for a current child. Reprepare current values through the existing AutoConfig path; no identity-name exception and no original checkpoint/default overlay copied.
capability_checks: Current parent path must reach the exact current child object.
Original context document-path registry key must agree with the source bundle component model type, architecture, modeling sources and supporting sources.
Class address is data only; no old checkpoint/value/proof travels on it.
Cache validates descriptor before lookup; exact descriptor and current source file hashes join current raw input in the preparation key. No heavy imports are needed to validate/replay.
Current PreparedDocument supplies current overlay to slot context; failed preparation cannot borrow historical defaults.
Existing decorator calls and cache keys are unchanged when no address override is provided.
proposed_root_checks: Original/scrubbed FLUX child diagnostics and per-field output comparison; no comparison exclusions added.
remaining_limits: Source diagnosis predicts rejected current child preparation as cause; actual root runtime must confirm FLUX recovery and no new structural delta.
The supported config-class address is the original AutoConfig registry key tied to exact resolved component sources; it does not prove mechanism or execution.
Same-process mutation of a third-party registry without changing its source/package versions is outside the existing persisted cache contract.
runtime: None executed by event_executor; AST syntax inspection only.
